title: Barn Preparation and Disinfection
content: Before day-old chicks arrive, the poultry barn must be completely cleared of old litter, power-washed under pressure, and sanitized. Whitewashing walls with 20% slaked lime significantly reduces bacterial load. Turn on heaters 24–48 hours prior to placement so the floor/bedding reaches 30–32°C and air temperature at chick height reaches 33–34°C. The dry bedding (wood shavings) should be at least 5–7 cm deep in summer and 7–10 cm in winter.

quiz.question: What floor/bedding and air temperatures are required upon day-old chick placement?
options: 30-32°C floor (bedding) and 33-34°C air at chick height
quiz.explanation: At placement, floor/litter temperature must reach 30-32°C and air temperature at chick height must be 33-34°C to prevent hypothermia and yolk sac infections.
